text:
Alex P: Heads up — Bay Area colo had a regional network blackout, vendor says a pallet with 12x H100s is stuck at forwarder. Need impact on Dedicated pools and RMA plan.
Maria S: Ugh. Which forwarder? ETA? any photos?
Kevin L: Forwarder = FastAir Logistics, manifest shows held at SJC sort facility. No ETA from carrier yet. Have AWB 123-FA-987654.
Jess T: Confirming affected Dedicated pool: pool-west-2-dedicated-3 (12 H100s). That was slated for preflight tomorrow. Might lose first-day capacity.
Alex P: Can we swap from EU or APAC spare pool to cover burst? Cost/latency tradeoffs?
Maria S: We have 6 H100s in EU-spare and 8 in APAC-edge but cross-region move adds egress + customs. Rough cost estimate: $12k per unit air rush + customs handling.
Kevin L: SupplyBot ran routing simulation: moving 6 units from APAC adds ~35ms to median p99 for some customers. If we only need to hold steady throughput, can shift non-latency-critical routes.
SupplyBot: Automated note: routing policy candidate = {"shift": "non-critical-traffic->apac", "expected_reduction": "40% p99 load"} 
Jess T: Also need RMA plan if units are DOA on arrival. Vendor says some units flagged for replacement earlier; forwarder is requesting SN verification before release.
Alex P: @Maria S can you confirm serial list and whether vendor will pre-authorize replacements without depot photos? If not, that adds 48-72h.
Maria S: Vendor (ZenithSupply) response: they can pre-authorize 6 unit temporary replacements if we sign expedited RMA form. They need digital manifest + photos for the rest.
Kevin L: Can we accept temporary replacements into Dedicated pool w/holdback policy? Risk: warranty handshake and accounting.
Jess T: Ops Oncall — can we hot-swap capacity via routing rules + put returned units into quarantine tag once they arrive?
Ops Oncall: Yes. Create a rollout plan: 1) shift 30% non-critical to APAC, 2) accept 6 temp units into pool-west-2-dedicated-3 with "quarantine-temp" tag, 3) mark 6 incoming units for full inspection on depot arrival.
Alex P: Sounds good. Maria, can you get vendor to send provisional AWB for temp replacements and confirm incoterms (DUTY paid?)
Maria S: On it. Vendor says provisional AWB available, incoterms DDP for temp replacements but we absorb return freight for failed units.
Kevin L: Also flagging networking: blackout caused MGMT VLAN flaps in the colo. If we bring temp units online, coordinate with colo NOC to avoid control-plane split.
Jess T: I'll open a runbook with NOC and tag the rollout: `rollout/6791234567-bayarea-temp-swap`. Steps + rollback.
Alex P: Cost question for Finance — if we accept temp replacements (DDP) and later vendor charges for returns, what's the accounting path? @Kevin L any CLAR?
Kevin L: We'll invoice to procurement temporary line, finance to reconcile with vendor credits later. Expect ~$72k immediate expense if we rush all 6.
Maria S: Vendor just sent provisional AWB: `AWB: 123-FA-RT-0001`, ETA to SJC hub 36h for temp shipment. Also attached provisional digital manifest.
Alex P: Great. Last ask: confirm RMA SLA on pre-auth replacements and whether we get SLA credit for pool downtime. If vendor refuses credits, we escalate to procurement.
Maria S: Quoting vendor: 48h guaranteed temp dispatch after form; SLA credit only for permanent replacements >7 days. I'll escalate.
Jess T: Ok team — action items: Maria escalate for SLA credit + AWB docs, Kevin coordinate finance estimate, Ops open rollout + NOC, Alex will confirm customer routing priorities. I'll post progress updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
